trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (trimmed_mean on pool1) and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable. The dataset card confirms trimmed_mean strategies are top performers, and the series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability—exactly the regime where a trimmed mean over the most stable subset is appropriate. More turns are unlikely to turn this noise-level gap into a real gain.

action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend_strength 0.99, no seasonality) with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.368) and a large redundant error-correlation group. A trimmed mean over the 5 most consistently ranked models (pool1) naturally down-weights the few weaker members while preserving the signal from the DWT/FT-transformed tree models that track the trend best. The runner-up (median, full pool) is statistically indistinguishable, and the dataset card independently confirms trimmed_mean as a top strategy. Accepting the seed leader is the right call.
